title: Quantitative Researcher Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Quantitative Researcher.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas Across Levels
lines: 1. Statistical Modeling & Alpha Discovery: Time series econometrics, signal generation, feature engineering from market microstructure and alternative datasets.
2. Backtesting & Overfitting Mitigation: Cross-validation methods, walk-forward testing, survivorship/lookahead bias prevention, and transaction cost modeling.
3. Portfolio Optimization & Risk: Mean-variance, Kelly criterion, factor models (Barra), maximum drawdown limits, and Value-at-Risk (VaR).
4. Mathematical & Machine Learning Depth: Stochastic calculus, linear algebra, reinforcement learning, and high-frequency statistical arbitrage.
